All the candidates at the June 2024 District 9 forum supported bringing street vendors back. They differed on how to protect vendors: Jaime Gutierrez and Julian Bermudez suggested a committee or commission including vendors; Bermudez also emphasized self-policing and giving sellers more power. Roberto Hernandez proposed bringing residents, merchants, vendors, cultural groups and city departments together to devise a plan. Stephen Torres and H. Brown called for designated vending spaces. Jackie Fielder argued for vendors’ voices in the discussion and protection from criminalization.
